name: Chillborn Vampiric Mist

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

sourceBooks: Monster Vault: Threats to the Nentir Vale
description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Siphoning Presence
traits.details: Enemies can’t spend healing surges in the aura. When an enemy ends its turn in the aura, it takes 5 cold and necrotic damage, and the mist gains 5 temporary hit points.

traits.name: Insubstantial
traits.details: The mist takes half damage from any damage source, except those that deal fire, force, or radiant damage. When it takes fire or radiant damage, it loses this trait until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Mist Form
traits.details: The mist can move through openings of any size. It can also enter other creatures’ spaces and end its turn there.

auras.name: Siphoning Presence
auras.details: Enemies can’t spend healing surges in the aura. When an enemy ends its turn in the aura, it takes 5 cold and necrotic damage, and the mist gains 5 temporary hit points.
